non_comparable_frozen.bisque: requires subjects assayed as BOTH bulk and single cells; Bisque's method IS the assay transform learned from paired subjects. Without overlap it estimates that transform from marginal distributions, which is its documented degraded mode. TCGA has no single-cell data, so this is not fixable from any file on disk -- it needs a genuinely paired cohort.
non_comparable_frozen.quantiseq: requires its own TIL10 signature and a matching gene space; quanTIseq ignores the supplied reference. It is reported separately wherever it runs, and it returned no finite estimates on either TCGA cohort.
non_comparable_frozen.scdc_ensemble: requires two or more references to weight across; With one reference there is nothing to ensemble; it reduces exactly to SCDC.
non_comparable_frozen.music: requires cross-donor variance (sigma) in the reference; MuSiC's entire contribution is weighting genes by cross-donor consistency. With a zero sigma it is residual-weighted NNLS, and returns numbers identical to NNLS.
non_comparable_frozen.epic: requires refProfiles.var (per-gene variance) in the reference; EPIC's published contribution is variance weighting. Without it the package warns and runs constrained least squares with uniform weights.
non_comparable_frozen.cibersortx_smode: requires the single cells the signature was built from; S-mode's batch correction is defined against the source cells; without them the method cannot run at all.
